# mentions anywhere are coreet_preflight.sh / coreet_preflight_controls.sh and a
# README, none of which is in the filelist path), so it is NOT an input.  It is
# left exactly where it is: not deleted, not stashed, not cleaned.
#   core-et pin  c72b6a2fe4aaad5a9eef437776864ff71f4b55d7  tracked tree CLEAN

# The four patched files are BYTE-IDENTICAL between the D4 repo and master; only
# map.tsv differs, and only in the absolute destination paths it embeds.
# CORRECTED -- D3's missing map.tsv is NOT a blocker to RUNNING.  `subst_of()`
# begins `[[ -r "$PATCH_MAP" ]] || { printf '%s' "$1"; return; }`, so an absent
# map makes the script fall back to the ORIGINAL source path.  Verified by
# running the pinned script from a snapshot with no map: rc=0, the four
# originals named instead of the patched copies, and the `// patched:` notes
# absent.  Absence changes the SUBSTITUTED INPUT BYTES, nothing else.  Both
# variants of the only affected block are frozen:
# The other nine have zero substitutions, so their two variants coincide.
# The CONTROLLED PAIRED EXPERIMENT uses the frozen MAPPED filelist on both
# sides, so the two sides see identical bytes.  D3's own in-place historical
# route -- which would use the originals -- is kept as separate provenance and
# is not silently swapped for the mapped one.
# HOW THE FILELISTS WERE PRODUCED (read-only; no build ran)
#   GNU Make 4.4.1, TECH=generic.  Order is dependency order and is preserved;
#   the lists are make-expanded, never text-parsed.
# TRANSITIVE INCLUDES, verified by scanning every consumed file for `include
# rather than by directory membership.  There are exactly eight `include
# directives across all 156 files, all eight in ONE file, intpipe_csr_file.sv,
# and that file is named by exactly ONE of the ten blocks: intpipe_decode.
# Six blocks carry the +incdir+ because coreet_filelist.sh adds it on
# `grep -q '/intpipe/csr/rtl/'` -- any file from that directory, e.g.
# intpipe_csr_file_conv.sv -- so five of them get an incdir they do not use.
# The eight headers are therefore inputs to intpipe_decode ONLY:
# 156 unique RTL/package files are consumed across the ten; every one was
# verified readable (0 missing).  Their full sha256 set is in
# headers' full hashes, the per-block header binding, the four patched copies'
# ORIGINALS, the ANCHOR and the per-block REF_SV digests.
